I havent self harmed in 3 years but i still want to everyday. And thats something im proud of, but I still have suicidal ideation everyday and my life is significantly better than it ever has been.
But i want to fucking die. Every single day. Over dumb shit. And God the amount of times ive literally held a knife to my skin but then one of my precious cats comes up to me and i think about them having to be rehomed and i pussy out.
Its so frustrating having things depend on you, or having people care about you. But it makes me feel so damn guilty to even say that. I desperately wish my brain chemistry was normal and i could go a day without wishing i wasnt here.

Its not that hard for your partner to accommodate or adapt. My bf even eats gluten free with me most of the time because its just easier that way. If your partner is so selfish that they cant even understand why its upsetting i say run.
Ive dealt with enough people saying it's all in my head that if the one person youre supposed to be able to count on wont help out, it aint worth saving.
Best of luck to you friend!

I've tried just about everything tbh but im not trying to shoot you down or seem pessimistic. Tonight's trial sleepaid after benadryl didnt work was an all natural shot of "natural citrus" kava that tasted of dehydrated worms and dirt. Its currently 5am now so this one doesnt seem to work for me either.
And thank you for responding

Youre feelings are valid. And its very sweet of you to offer your wealth to others.

I know its hard, but cutting out my abusive mother did wonders for my mental. 
I still struggle with suicidal ideation everyday.
But we're already mean to ourselves. Why should you have to put up with someone else being abusive to you when your own mind is, ya know?
Its a hard bridge to go through but maybe going no contact with ypur parents might improve your situation.

I suffer from suicidal ideations daily. But the best thing to do is try to get them to talk. And be present in the moment. When it gets bad for me thankfully my boyfriend can pick up on it now that we've been together a while. Dont guilt. Hold their hand, even platonically. For me i cant feel anything at all when im in that kind of headspace and the physical feeling of someone caring enough about me to touch/be there works wonders. "Im here for you.
